hb.tipps: Saving tips for your biggest items
hb.tipp.miete: Check whether you can get housing benefit (Wohngeld). Have the service charge statement checked, for example by a tenants' association or with “Check a letter”.
hb.tipp.energie: Compare your electricity use with the Stromspiegel. Check your tariff and switching supplier. The energy advice of the consumer advice centre helps.
hb.tipp.handy: After the minimum term you can cancel mobile and internet contracts with one month's notice (§ 56 TKG). Then compare cheaper tariffs.
hb.tipp.vers: Above all, personal liability insurance is important. Check whether you have insurance twice or do not need it, for example for a phone or glasses.
hb.tipp.mobil: Check cheap tickets, for example the Deutschlandticket, a social ticket from your town or a job ticket. Ask your transport association or your town.
hb.tipp.essen: Plan the week and write a shopping list. Use own brands and special offers and use up leftovers. You find cheap recipes under “Save money”.
hb.tipp.kinder: For school supplies, lunch, trips and clubs there may be money from the education package (Bildung und Teilhabe). Also check the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag).
hb.tipp.raten: Do not take out a new loan to pay old debts. Non-profit debt advice is usually free, for example at welfare organisations, consumer advice centres or your town.
hb.tipp.sonst: Go through your subscriptions and memberships, for example streaming, gym or magazines. Cancel what you do not use.

hb.hw.wb: {l}: the approval period ends on {d}. Apply for continued payment in good time.
hb.hw.wb.d: Without a new application, payment stops at the end of the approval period. Housing benefit (Wohngeld) is only paid from the month of the application. You apply to the office that pays the benefit.
hb.hw.ek: Your income has changed: before about {alt}, now about {neu}.
hb.hw.ek.d: If your income changes, an entitlement can change too. With Grundsicherungsgeld or social assistance (Sozialhilfe) you must report changes immediately (§ 60 Abs. 1 SGB I). With housing benefit (Wohngeld) you must report if your income rises permanently by more than 15 % (§ 27 Abs. 3 WoGG). With the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) the change usually only counts at the next application. If in doubt, ask.
hb.hw.melden: Report the change to the office
hb.hw.briefLabel: Template for the notice (in German, you can change it)
hb.hw.knapp: Little is left. Check whether you are entitled to benefits.
hb.hw.knapp.d: Housing benefit (Wohngeld), child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) or Grundsicherungsgeld are possible even if you work. The benefits check shows what may apply to you.
hb.hw.nk: A back payment for service charges may be covered by the Jobcenter or social welfare office (Sozialamt).
hb.hw.nk.d: The back payment counts as housing costs in the month it is due (§ 22 Abs. 1 SGB II, § 35 SGB XII). This can help even if you do not otherwise receive benefits. Hand in the statement straight away. With “Check a letter” you can check the statement. Apply in the same month in which it is due.
hb.hw.kaputt: Something important is broken? A loan from the office may be possible.
hb.hw.kaputt.d: With Grundsicherungsgeld, the Jobcenter may give a loan for an essential need that cannot wait, for example a new fridge (§ 24 Abs. 1 SGB II). It is later deducted in instalments from the benefit (§ 42a SGB II). The social welfare office (Sozialamt) works similarly (§ 37 Abs. 1 SGB XII). Apply before you buy.
hb.hw.but: There may be money for school supplies, class trips, lunch or clubs.
hb.hw.but.d: Families with Grundsicherungsgeld, social assistance, housing benefit (Wohngeld) or child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) get the education package (Bildung und Teilhabe) (§ 28 SGB II, § 34 SGB XII, § 6b BKGG). The benefits check shows whether it may apply to you.
hb.hw.schulden: You pay instalments or debts. There is free help and the garnishment calculator.
hb.hw.schulden.d: Non-profit debt advice is usually free. A garnishment protection account (P-Konto) protects your money up to a limit.
hb.hw.tarif: You may be able to get an exemption from the broadcasting fee. Also ask about social tariffs.
hb.hw.tarif.d: With Grundsicherungsgeld, social assistance or basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter), an exemption from the broadcasting fee is possible (§ 4 Abs. 1 RBStV). You apply to the Beitragsservice. Ask your town about a social ticket and your provider about a social tariff.
hb.hw.tarif0: Ask about social tickets and social tariffs.
hb.hw.tarif0.d: Some towns have a social ticket for buses and trains, some providers a social tariff. Ask your town and your provider.
hb.wb.t: Enter the end date from your notice. Shortly before, the app reminds you when you open it.
hb.wb.sgb12: Basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter) (social welfare office (Sozialamt))
hb.wb.quelle: Usual periods: Grundsicherungsgeld usually 12 months (§ 41 Abs. 3 SGB II), basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter) usually 12 months (§ 44 Abs. 3 SGB XII), housing benefit (Wohngeld) usually 12 months (§ 25 Abs. 1 WoGG), child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) 6 months (§ 6a Abs. 7 BKGG). The date in your notice counts.
